paragraphs.text: Verix and Karox Bladewing are a mating pair of dragons and the leaders of the Bladewing brood , both descendants of Rorix Bladewing and the parents of Tarox Bladewing .

Verix Bladewing and her mate, Karox, are the leaders of the Bladewing Brood. Their child, Tarox, is the pride of his brood and hopes to one day seize control of the dragon nations from Darigaaz . Their undead progenitor, Rorix, has terrorized the skies of Otaria for centuries. Verix and Karox mourn his pitiful existence and are prepared to take down their ancestor for good.
